siesta.note: The full rest interval, then act, then speak. The grand tour and the spine of the arc: every hub spoke in turn (the hub hides each once taken), Veran pressed on the geometry, Chorik drawn out (-> chorik_unguarded, which unlocks Aftermath's gated 'Speak up' branch), then wait out the interval, move on the housing, and say something true. Longest thread, so it carries the deepest story-so-far and should be woven first.
path: Check in on the quiet one

witness.note: The quiet run: sit, let Chorik alone rather than pressing him, wait the interval out, and get clear when the pylon goes live. Covers Chorik's 'Let him be' (the alternative to drawing him out) and Completion's 'Get clear of the pylon' walk-away.
path: Check in on the quiet one

silence.note: Reach the aftermath and say nothing. Covers Aftermath's 'Walk away without speaking' ending. Deliberately skips the rest-interval conversations so the ending is reached by a PC who never learned the crew's names.

roadside.note: The off-ramp at the road: decline the tea and keep walking (-> flee_dungeon). Covers Start's 'Walk on' beat, which nothing else reaches.

leave.note: The second off-ramp: take the tea, then decide the work site is not your concern and go (-> flee_dungeon). Covers The Rest Interval's 'Walk off the work site' beat.
